_comment: The press kit's asset manifest, read by three places that must agree: src/app/press/page.tsx renders it, scripts/build-press.mjs copies the named files out of store/marketing into public/press/, and scripts/check-press.mjs asserts every one of them reached the export. A file named here and missing from store/marketing fails the build rather than shipping a broken image on the one page journalists load.

shots.title: The board
shots.alt: A Six on the Dial board: six letters on a circular dial below six empty rows, each row carrying a written clue.
shots.caption: Six letters on the dial. Six rows to fill, and a written clue on every one.

shots.title: Mid-solve
shots.alt: The same board part-solved, with several rows filled in and the rest still open.
shots.caption: Every answer is spelled from the same six letters, and nothing else.

shots.title: The packs
shots.alt: The themed pack catalogue, listing packs by name with a short line of description under each.
shots.caption: Themed packs sit alongside the daily board. The clues in them are researched and cited.

shots.title: Progress
shots.alt: The rank and progress sheet, showing the player's rank mark and boards cleared.
shots.caption: Rank and progress, kept on the device and nowhere else.

shots.title: The rules
shots.alt: The rules sheet, explaining the six-letter constraint and how hints work.
shots.caption: The whole rule set fits on one sheet.

shots.title: Light theme
shots.alt: The same board rendered in the light theme.
shots.caption: Dark and light, both drawn to the same contrast floor.
